abstract: We investigated changes in the activity and subcellular distribution of cyclic-AMP-dependent protein kinases (cAMP-PKs) in response to treatment with retinoic acid in three different embryonal carcinoma cell lines derived from the same teratoma 6050. After retinoic-acid treatment, F9 and PCC4 cells gave rise to parietal-like endoderm, while PC13 cells differentiated into visceral endoderm. Retinoid treatment of F9 and PCC4 cells caused an increase in cAMP-PK activity as measured by histone phosphorylation, as well as increases in the amount of the RI and RII regulatory subunits of the cAMP-PKs, as quantitated by photoaffinity labeling with 8-azido-cyclic-32P-AMP, in both the soluble and plasma-membrane fractions. The increases in membrane cAMP-PK activity and RI and RII levels reached their maximum within 18 h of retinoid treatment, and then dropped to intermediate levels after 3 days of treatment. The cytosolic activity and the levels of the regulatory subunits exhibited a progressive increase during the 3 days of exposure to retinoic acid. The relative RI/RII ratios in the cytosol and membrane fractions of the treated cells were comparable to those found in established PYS-2 parietal-endoderm cells. PC13 stem cells had high levels of cAMP-PK activity and cAMP binding to the regulatory subunits in both the cytosol and plasma membranes, while also exhibiting very low levels of type-II cAMP-PK. Retinoid treatment induced a progressive increase in cAMP-PK activity in the cytosol, and a decrease in activity at the membrane level.(ABSTRACT TRUNCATED AT 250 WORDS)
abstract_ja: レチノイン酸処理に対するcAMP依存性プロテインキナーゼ（cAMP-PK）の活性と細胞内分布の変化を、同一の奇形腫6050に由来する3種の胎児性癌細胞株で検討した。レチノイン酸処理後、F9およびPCC4細胞は壁側内胚葉様細胞へ分化し、PC13細胞は臓側内胚葉へ分化した。F9およびPCC4細胞のレチノイド処理は、ヒストンリン酸化で測定したcAMP-PK活性の増加、ならびに8-アジド-環状-32P-AMPによるフォトアフィニティーラベリングで定量したRIおよびRIIの制御サブユニット量の増加をもたらし、いずれも可溶性画分と原形質膜画分の両方で認められた。膜のcAMP-PK活性とRI・RIIの量は処理後18時間で最大に達した後、3日目には中間レベルまで低下した。細胞質の活性と制御サブユニットの量は、レチノイン酸暴露の3日間にわたり漸進的な増加を示した。処理細胞の細胞質と膜画分におけるRI/RII比は、確立されたPYS-2壁側内胚葉細胞のそれと同程度であった。PC13幹細胞は細胞質と原形質膜の両方で高いcAMP-PK活性とcAMP結合を示し、同時に非常に低いII型cAMP-PKレベルを示した。レチノイド処理はPC13の細胞質におけるcAMP-PK活性を漸進的に増加させ、膜レベルでは活性を低下させた。（抄録は250語で打ち切られています）
